description: Find any page of Apple's documentation by its title, at once: API symbols (types, methods, properties, enum cases, macros), articles, samples, web-service endpoints, Info.plist and entitlement keys, Human Interface Guidelines and App Store Connect Help pages. Use it when you know a name or part of one, from code, an error or another page. Returns each match's title, kind, Beta or Deprecated mark, technology, the page it sits under (which tells same-named members apart) and link, shortest titles first; read one with get_apple_doc_content. It matches titles only, so to search by what something does, use search_apple_docs. Pages Apple added after the map's date, given in each answer, are missing: source "index" reads one framework's sidebar live and matches a wildcard ("*View" structs in SwiftUI, "*Delegate" protocols in UIKit), to see a family of APIs or what's newer than the map, without summaries.

kind.description: Keeps one kind of page, as the results name it ("struct", "method", "case", "protocol", "article"); an unknown one is answered with the kinds there are.

limit.description: Most results: from the map, the shortest titles first (10 if left out); from an index, in its order (50).

query.description: map: text the title contains, in any case and as typed, without wildcards: a name ("accessibilityInputLabels(_:)"), part of one ("inputlabels") or a word ("gauge"). index: a wildcard for the whole name, in any case: "*View" ends in View, "UI*" starts with UI, "*feedback*" contains it, "registerForTraitChanges*" finds a method by its name, "*" takes every one.

source.description: "map": the docs map on disk, every technology at once. "index": one framework's sidebar, read live from Apple's site, for pages newer than the map or a family of names by wildcard; technology names the framework.

technology.description: map: keeps only the pages these technologies' sidebars list (WebKit's WebView is in SwiftUI's), by the names the results show ("SwiftUI", "Human Interface Guidelines") or IDs ("swiftui"), in any case. index: the one framework, by its name in any case and spacing ("Foundation Models") or its ID ("foundationmodels").

name: search_docs_map
title: Search Docs Map
